_comment: CANONICAL faithful page layouts — the single source of truth for the student CRM view, student workbook, and teacher flipbook. Each page is an ordered list of regions; text regions hold VERIFIED transcriptions (checked against the official workbook), picture cells / illustration slots hold `illustrationSrc` paths to faithful COLOR crops from the art pipeline (public/cartilla/art/faithful/manifest.json). A page absent here has no verified layout yet and renders its surface's existing fallback. NOTHING here is placeholder or invented — pages are added lesson-by-lesson only after the owner verifies them. Pictures without a real crop show an explicit 'pendiente' marker, never an invented drawing.
_status: ALL 24 LESSONS complete for their writing page + core letter/syllables/sentences page: Lecciones 2-6 (vowels O,A,E,I,U) + Lecciones 7-24 (consonants M,P,S,T,D,L,N,Ñ,B,V,R,rr,G,F,J,C,Y,Z). Every lesson's matching (circle-the-syllable / trace-a-line) and fill-in-the-blank pages are intentionally deferred — same policy applied consistently throughout, since those are picture- or interactive-layout-driven and not yet worth building faithfully. All text transcribed from the owner-uploaded workbook PDF and cross-checked page-by-page; picture-grid illustrations show honest 'pendiente' markers pending the art pipeline. AWAITING OWNER VERIFICATION before this is considered final.
